title: bulkOperationRunQuery fails because another bulk operation is already running for the shop
symptoms: A bulk query operation for this app and shop is already in progress
A second export started by another job or worker never begins
The bulk result URL stops working about a week after the run
cause: On API versions before 2026-01 an app can run only one bulk query and one bulk mutation per shop at a time. From 2026-01 the cap is five concurrent bulk queries, and result URLs expire after one week.
fix: Move to API 2026-01 or later for concurrent queries, otherwise serialize bulk jobs per shop, and download results promptly.
affected: GraphQL Admin API bulk operations; one at a time before 2026-01, five queries from 2026-01
